selection: Select the highest joint-score identity-consistent event and the largest trajectory-to-image score decrease among eligible shared-particle artifacts. For visibility, all 144-pixel crops must lie inside the image, both tracks must fit inside the pre-event crop, and the terminating track must still exist four frames before the candidate. The true-event frame is within one frame of the candidate. The artifact has a shared-component fraction of at least 7/9 and, in nine preceding frames, at least five distinct frames supporting the same truth particle, at least two mapped observations from each track ID, and no different truth identity. The visibility criteria were fixed using the previous version before examining this new dataset. Simultaneous duplicate truth assignments are impossible under the one-to-one mapping. Selection affects illustration only; no fit or performance threshold is changed.
focus: continuing-track smoothed depth at each displayed frame; no manual refocus

label_audit.identity_window: strict t-1 parents and t+1 daughter; no imputation
label_audit.illustration_identity_metadata: For all candidates, including spatial negatives, join the saved XY truth mapping at the terminating-track end frame and continuing-track candidate frame. This is illustration metadata only.
